caption: The drawing depicts a round, dark-colored metal trivet with an ornate, symmetrical design consisting of curved and linear elements arranged around a central circular hub. The trivet has three short legs, each shaped like a paw or claw, positioned equidistant around the perimeter. The metalwork features an openwork pattern with scrolling motifs enclosed within the circular frame. The overall color is a deep, muted brownish-gray, giving the object a metallic appearance. The background is a plain, light, off-white color with no additional objects or designs present. The artist’s signature, "Margaret Colden," appears below the feet of the trivet in small, light script.
title: Trivet
